relations.subject: Ermenegildo La Terza
relations.evidence: After Liceo classico di Putignano studied at Naples. Graduated at Naples as student of Kerbaker.

relations.subject: Ermenegildo La Terza
relations.evidence: From 1904 Docent of Sanskrit at Naples (libero docente di filologia sanscrita), later Incaricato di filologia indoeuropea there.

relations.subject: Ermenegildo La Terza
relations.evidence: In 1923-24 Incaricato di letteratura latina at Università di Messina.

relations.subject: Ermenegildo La Terza
relations.evidence: From 1925 Director (presidente) of R. Liceo Scient. di Napoli, also taught comparative linguistics at the University (until 1935).
